\[ 2^{2k} \lesssim 3k n^2 \implies 2^k \lesssim \sqrt{3k} n \]

\[ k \le \log_2 n + \frac{1}{2}\log_2 k + \mathcal O(1) \implies k \le \log_2 n + \frac{1}{2}\log_2 \log_2 n + \mathcal O(1) \]
